verdict.rationale: The official pscale CLI documents creating, deleting and listing Vitess, Neki and Postgres databases and branches, and opening a secure MySQL or PostgreSQL shell. It also offers non-interactive SQL via `pscale sql`, and changelog entries add inspection commands for Insights query stats, regions, switchovers and point-in-time branch restores. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a dedicated connect/proxy or connection-string workflow beyond the shell, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI daily loop.
